# Workitem 06 — Create Hierarchical Clustering Week

## Purpose

When Swamy reaches hierarchical clustering, create a fresh four-layer week bundle under `src/weekN/`.

## Scope

- Use preserved reference material only to understand the topic.
- Write new zero-copy notes, quizzes, notebook explanations, and discussion examples.
- Leave preserved archive folders unchanged.

## Target Bundle

- `src/weekN/01-notes/hierarchical-clustering.md`
- `src/weekN/02-quizzes/hierarchical-clustering-quiz.md`
- `src/weekN/03-notebooks/hierarchical-clustering-implementation.ipynb`
- `src/weekN/04-discussions/hierarchical-clustering-discussion.md`

## Acceptance Criteria

- Notes explain agglomerative clustering, linkage methods, dendrograms, and distance measures.
- Notebook implements the core clustering logic from scratch for a small dataset.
- Visualizations include a dendrogram or equivalent hierarchy plot.
- Discussion includes an original clustering decision scenario.
- CI and markdown lint pass.
